verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a public GitHub repository and first-party references to an "OpenHands Open Source" offering and an "open-source" Agent Canvas client, so the source is readable and described as open source. The pack never names the license, and the separate "licensed self-hosting" Enterprise tier suggests not every component is openly licensed. Missing for 10: the specific open license (e.g., MIT or Apache) named in the evidence, clarity on which components are open versus commercially licensed, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: OpenHands Open Source and OpenHands Cloud plans offer support to bring your own LLM keys.
Agent Canvas is the open-source browser client and control center for agent conversations and automations.
